entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Yeah, yeah. Just get me someone.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return something I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure. The name is Alex Rios. Order is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on January 14th. To process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?
It's a preference. I just don't like it.
I understand. I see here that you've had the device for about five days. Let me just check the current return policy for you.

Okay, thank you for your patience. It looks like your item is eligible for return. Our policy allows for returns on most items within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I can go ahead and process that for you right now.
Whatever. Just tell me what I need to do.

Of course. I have just initiated the return in our system. I've sent an email to the address on file; it contains a prepaid shipping label and instructions. You'll just need to pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. That usually takes about 3 to 5 business days after we receive it.
Right. I guess that's everything then.
Great. Was there anything else I could help you with today, Alex?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. We hope to see you again soon. Have a great day.
